_doc: Where every piece of raw art under pixellab/ came from: the PixelLab job, its prompt and seed, and the sha1 of the file kept. Panels and control sheets come from create_ui_asset.

master/master_b.png.palette: black chrome, deep navy, neon cyan, hot magenta, amber
master/master_b.png.prompt: synthwave 80s arcade game window: thick black chrome frame with a double glowing neon outline, cyan outer line and magenta inner line, tiny amber pixel corner brackets, very dark navy interior, pixel art game UI, crisp 1px outlines, clean straight edges, flat front view, no text
master/master_b.png.note: chosen over a gunmetal-and-rivets variant (job 1f77c20a-d64a-4b2c-a0f6-87429743f863); also reference/master.png

controls/controls_neon.png.pieces: button, button_alt, pad_key, corner_key, toggle, panel_slim, dpad (circle), badge at exact sizes
controls/controls_neon.png.prompt: sprite sheet of separate matching synthwave arcade game UI elements on transparent background: each shape is its own small framed widget with a black chrome bevelled border, a thin glowing neon cyan outline and a thin magenta inner line, tiny amber corner brackets, and a very dark navy inner face; crisp 1px pixel art outlines, straight edges, flat front view, no text, no icons
